facts.text: Hapeville was named after Dr. Hape, the town’s founder, whose legacy lives on in its streets and history.
The city’s historic downtown has been revitalized by new residential construction, turning old warehouses into trendy lofts and cafés.
Comedian Jeff Foxworthy grew up in Hapeville, graduating from Hapeville High School before becoming a national comedy star.
From 1947 to 2006, the Ford Atlanta Assembly Plant in Hapeville produced the Taurus, shaping the city’s industrial past.
Porsche’s North American headquarters houses a restoration facility, service center, and a track segment right in Hapeville’s borders.
The Hapeville Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places, preserves the city’s architectural heritage for future generations.
